what: The public change log of /omega/: one dated entry per change of the page or of its state. The builder refuses when the newest entry’s state is not the records’.

entries.what: The page opens, public and listed. The pre-registration was sealed at 02:52 UTC on 25 November, before any run: twenty rows in three phases, the verdict rule and seven gaps read at the pin. Phase 1 runs on a rented machine; the pin step is under way. Both blind statements are written and sealed before elaboration: writer B (GPT-6.2-astra) at about 03:03 UTC, writer A (a Claude agent) at 03:06 UTC. The statement reader, the two readings of the lower-bound proof and the provenance scout are at work.
